title: Sliding Window Pattern
definition: Used for 'Subarray' or 'Substring' problems. Identify it when a question asks for 'Longest/Shortest continuous sequence' or 'Max/Min sum of K consecutive elements'.
simpleExplanation: The ultimate tool for handling 'Continuous' or 'Sub-something' questions.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Sliding Window Pattern.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Sliding Window Pattern to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Sliding Window Pattern into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Sliding Window Pattern.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Sliding Window Pattern from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
